greeting: ^Stupid cloud formations. Of course it was silly of me to think the clouds would be any different today.
^I predict this storm is going to be a bad one, Barrington. I’m not sure how hard it’ll be to weather this one.
^I mean, I can easily swing through the trees with my tail, but yours seems to be cut a bit short.
^Here, take this item. I can’t quite make sense of it, but you might be able to swing along with me.
^But hurry, I can’t predict when the thunder will start.
